items.text: Angélica María Dueñas is a human resources specialist and member of the Los Angeles County Democratic Party Central Committee. She served as president and vice president of the Sun Valley Area Neighborhood Council and was a delegate for Bernie Sanders to the 2016 and 2020 Democratic National Conventions. She holds a bachelor's degree in political science and public administration from California State University, Los Angeles, and a master's degree in organizational leadership from Woodbury University. She said in 2024 that Senator Bernie Sanders' 2016 presidential run inspired her to seek public office.

sentences.text: Angélica María Dueñas is a human resources specialist and member of the Los Angeles County Democratic Party Central Committee.
She served as president and vice president of the Sun Valley Area Neighborhood Council and was a delegate for Bernie Sanders to the 2016 and 2020 Democratic National Conventions.

She holds a bachelor's degree in political science and public administration from California State University, Los Angeles, and a master's degree in organizational leadership from Woodbury University.
She said in 2024 that Senator Bernie Sanders' 2016 presidential run inspired her to seek public office.

items.text: Her 2024 campaign website listed priorities including a Green New Deal, Medicare for All, immigration reform, and criminal justice reform. In a 2018 survey, she said her top three priorities were ending all wars, universal healthcare, and tuition-free education with federal loan forgiveness. In the survey, she also expressed support for universal rent control and for local governments to seize bank-owned homes to house people through HUD and Section 8 programs.
